notes: Base weights are adjusted by draft zone and team phase inside prediction.ts before normalization.
Use baseline as the default board; compare other scenarios for disputed picks.

scenarios.label: balanced baseline
scenarios.whenToUse: Default first board before late breaking news.

scenarios.label: media consensus heavy
scenarios.whenToUse: When latest mock drafts are stable and team-specific data is weak.
scenarios.risk: Misses team-specific reaches or late-breaking moves.

scenarios.label: team need heavy
scenarios.whenToUse: When team needs and priorityTags have been reviewed by A5.
scenarios.risk: Bad tags can create cascading wrong picks.

scenarios.label: late intel heavy
scenarios.whenToUse: Final hours with reliable updated mockHeat, medical, workout, or trade signals.
scenarios.risk: Overweights stale or noisy intel if source data is not refreshed.
